channel.title: AI Daily News
channel.description: Daily curated AI news, 10 articles max. Curated, credible, traceable.

item.title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
item.description: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

item.title: Broad access through consistent standards
item.description: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.

item.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
item.description: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

item.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
item.description: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.

item.title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
item.description: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

item.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
item.description: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

item.title: Cloudflare links vulnerability discovery to defense with OpenAI
item.description: Cloudflare uses OpenAI Daybreak to investigate vulnerabilities and propose fixes for review. Its developers use Codex to build faster and improve code quality.

item.title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
item.description: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

item.title: Democratic governance of frontier AI, part II: Empowering cyber defenders
item.description: OpenAI outlines a blueprint for empowering cyber defenders with frontier AI, stronger safeguards, modernized cybersecurity, and more resilient public institutions.

item.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
item.description: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.
